name: megaprobe
description: Scout first, then spend: a cheap scout explores, megaprobe verifies its claims, the cheapest fitting worker makes the change, checks decide whether to escalate.

interface.longDescription: Runs a coding task as a staged pipeline: a cheap read-only scout, code-verified handoff, the cheapest fitting worker, then typecheck, lint and tests with escalation to a stronger model on failure.
defaultPrompt: Use megaprobe to fix the failing test in src/auth
